div.p:
In accordance with the Governing Disciplinary Policy and Regulations of Bunna Bank S.C.,
against you effective for the payroll period of .

Please be reminded that this notice constitutes an official disciplinary record placed in your personnel file. Management expects you to strictly abide by the Bank's Code of Conduct, policies, and operational procedures in all future assignments. You are expressly cautioned that any recurrent breach or repetition of similar disciplinary infractions shall attract escalated punitive measures, up to and including separation under Article 33 of the Disciplinary Regulation.

p.t: This disciplinary determination represents the final and conclusive decision of Bunna Bank S.C. following the completion of statutory appeal proceedings, and is immediately binding with no further administrative appeal.

Pursuant to the Bank's Disciplinary Policy, you have the right to lodge a formal written appeal against this decision within ten (10) calendar days from the receipt date of this notice
(Statutory Appeal Deadline: ) . Any appeal submitted after the expiration of the statutory 10-day period shall not be entertained.

Subject: – Notice of Precautionary Suspension With Pay

div.p:
This is to formally notify you that in connection with the ongoing disciplinary proceedings under Case concerning alleged misconduct under , the Bank Management has resolved to place you on precautionary suspension effective from to
( working days).

div.t-esc: o.reason or 'Precautionary suspension pending audit investigation and disciplinary inquiry.'

ol.li: Access Restriction: Your ERP system credentials, internal application access, and physical premises access to Bank work areas are temporarily suspended for the duration of this inquiry.

t.li: Salary Withholding: In accordance with Bank Disciplinary Policy, payment of monthly salary is withheld during the active period of this unpaid precautionary suspension. Final salary settlement and backpayment (if applicable) will be determined upon final resolution of your case.

ol.li: Availability for Inquiry: You are required to remain reachable and available to appear before the Audit Directorate and the Disciplinary Committee whenever summoned for interviews, clarifications, or hearings.

div.p: This suspension is a precautionary administrative measure to ensure a fair and unimpeded investigation and does not constitute a final determination of guilt.
